_why: Stage 4 preset browser: the generic stub's bland 'Default / Preset A' list would leave the select, the factory labelers and the delete popover unmeasured at real widths. These are the 9 factory file names in table order (PresetRecipes.h) plus one user preset, in the shapes PluginEditor.cpp returns: getPresetList = the walk order (string array), getPresetCatalog = { factory: [{ name, id }], user: [names] } (object), getCurrentPreset = the fresh-instance name.
